experiment: V10 — configuration-only reasoning-effort escalation at BUILD (low → medium)
baseline_note: Same merged V8 reasoning-effort seam as V9 (PR #53, head cc958c1). No code changes for V10 — configuration only. Patch parser/applier, edit policy, E21/E23, V3 repair, V4 continuation, retry/empty-output behavior all frozen unchanged.
sole_intervention: full-build/build reasoning effort changes from "low" (V9) to "medium". BUILD completion budget unchanged at 16384. DESIGN, PLAN remain 32768 with no reasoning override; TEST remains 32768 + low. The intervention targets the V9-established bottleneck: edit-generation/serialization quality (2/3 V9 BUILD failures were patch-arithmetic rejects; 1/3 output-bearing exhaustion), not capacity.

outcome_taxonomy.claim: BUILD clears (validator PASS, workflow advances past build) in at least 2 of 3 treatment opportunities — patch serialization precision scales with reasoning depth and the V9 defect classes fall below the strict applier's threshold.
outcome_taxonomy.discriminates: O3/O4 (if clears occur, medium was sufficient; if not, either quality or budget bound)

outcome_taxonomy.claim: The zero-visible A-class signature returns under medium (finish=length, ~0 visible bytes, reasoning at/near the 16,384 ceiling) — the V7/V8 runaway-reasoning regime re-engages between low and max.
outcome_taxonomy.discriminates: whether the low-effort suppression of A-class survives a one-step effort increase

outcome_taxonomy.claim: BUILD continues producing visible output but still fails patch/application correctness under medium (count inflation / oldStart drift / whitespace truncation per the V9 replay taxonomy) — serialization precision is not restored by medium.
outcome_taxonomy.discriminates: O1 vs O3 on the 2/3 V9 patch-reject share

outcome_taxonomy.claim: BUILD produces valid/near-valid visible synthesis but exhausts the unchanged 16,384 ceiling before publishing a result block (V9-2 class) — budget, not quality, is the residual binding constraint.
outcome_taxonomy.discriminates: O1 vs O4 on the 1/3 V9 exhaustion share

outcome_taxonomy.claim: At least one workflow publishes the required code edit and passes downstream Gate B (workflow terminal success) — the campaign's first complete end-to-end run.
outcome_taxonomy.discriminates: block-level success regardless of which per-run path achieves it

per_opportunity_evidence_requirements: For EVERY BUILD treatment opportunity preserve: requested max_tokens + reasoning.effort as sent; route/provider; turn count; finish_reason; visible bytes; reasoning bytes; continuation involvement (fired? eligible? outcome); format-repair involvement; patch parse result (exact PatchApplyError or success); per-hunk count validity (declared vs derived); oldStart/context matching analysis (drift per hunk); base hash verified; apply result; required-edit satisfaction; downstream Gate B if the workflow completes. The V9 replay tooling (parse/derive/anchor) is the observation harness for the patch-stage fields.
sampling_rule: Run until 3 evaluable BUILD treatment opportunities or 9 evaluable workflows, whichever occurs first. A treatment opportunity is an evaluable workflow that reaches the build step. Ordinary upstream failures consume workflow slots only. Transport-censored executions consume neither counter and are re-run. Any implementation, evidence, or procedure defect stops the block immediately.
reporting_requirements: workflow denominator: N evaluable workflows; BUILD reached X/N
continuation_rule: Frozen V4 semantics unchanged: continuation fires only at turn == threshold+1 with max_tokens stop, NON-EMPTY visible text, no tool use, unspent budget. Zero-text exhaustion is never continuable.
constraint: No tuning between runs. No mechanism changes (no canonicalization, no parser/applier edits — V9 replay RESULT B stands: canonicalization rejected as next intervention). No V11 preregistration until this block closes and the operator reviews the evidence.
block_disposition: At rule termination: journal all runs with the per-opportunity evidence, report denominators + end-to-end count + outcome classification, freeze the block record, and STOP for operator block review.
